original_value: Smart, secure and energy-efficient data collection (DC) processes are key to the realization of the full potentials of future Internet of Things (FIoT)-based systems. Currently, challenges in this domain have motivated research efforts towards providing cognitive solutions for IoT usage. One such solution, termed cognitive sensing (CS) describes the use of smart sensors to intelligently perceive inputs from the environment. Further, CS has been proposed for use in FIoT in order to facilitate smart, secure and energy-efficient data collection processes. In this article, we provide a survey of different Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based techniques used over the last decade to provide cognitive sensing solutions for different FIoT applications. We present some state-of-the-art approaches, potentials, and challenges of AI techniques for the identified solutions. This survey contributes to a better understanding of AI techniques deployed for cognitive sensing in FIoT as well as future research directions in this regard.

Today, challenges in this area have driven research toward cognitive solutions for IoT use. One such approach, cognitive sensing (CS), uses smart sensors to intelligently perceive environmental inputs. CS has also been proposed for FIoT to enable smart, secure, and energy-efficient data collection. In this article, we survey Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based techniques used over the past decade to deliver cognitive sensing solutions for various FIoT applications. We highlight state-of-the-art approaches, the potential of AI techniques, and the challenges associated with the identified solutions. This survey aims to improve understanding of AI techniques used for cognitive sensing in FIoT, along with future research directions in this area.
